summary.text: Dennis Nehring is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 23 since May 6, 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Nehring earned a bachelor's degree from North Dakota State University and served in the U.S. Army, according to Ballotpedia.
He works as a rancher and served on the Williams County Public School District 8 School Board before the district became the Williston Basin School District 7.
In May 2024, the District 23 Republican organization appointed him to the House seat vacated by Scott Dyk.
